report.verdict: An emergency department nurse manager whose profile connects staffing decisions to patient flow, retention and budget results.
write_up: This is a strong profile! A recruiter can see an emergency department nurse manager leading a 42-bed ED and changing how it staffs and moves patients.

The current Saguaro Valley job is the model: you name the staffing changes, the drop in RN turnover and the labor budget you own. Your About brings the front-door triage work forward, so a reader doesn't have to hunt for it.

You don't need a rewrite. If you're discussing director-level work, you could add how you plan staffing and labor spending. Your profile isn't likely to be the reason a recruiter moves on; the role's requirements and whether it interests you also matter.

cards.where: Saguaro Valley Medical Center, Nurse Manager description
cards.line: Brought RN turnover down from 24% to 13% by moving to self-scheduling and a paid preceptor track.
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this line. It connects two staffing changes to the drop in turnover, so a recruiter can see both what you did and what changed.

cards.where: Saguaro Valley Medical Center, Nurse Manager description
cards.line: Own a $14.5M labor budget; finished the last two fiscal years within 1% of plan.
cards.cannot_tell: The budget result is strong. For a director-level conversation, the next question is how you plan staffing and labor spending across the year.
cards.example: Own a $14.5M labor budget; finished the last two fiscal years within 1% of plan. [How you plan staffing and labor spending across the year].
cards.question: What part do you play in planning staffing and labor spending across the year?

fit.why: Your headline, current job and About all describe managing an emergency department, including staffing, patient flow and a labor budget.
fit.level: manager, your current Nurse Manager, Emergency Department title and responsibility for 96 nurses and techs
fit.note: 'Emergency Department Nurse Manager' and 'throughput' are in your headline. 'Nurse Staffing' is among your top skills, and 'split-flow' is in your About. 'Labor budget' is in your current job. Budget forecasting and quality improvement are optional search terms if they describe your work.
